name: deskmcp-gateway
description: DeskMCP — open-source local-first desktop bridge for ChatGPT
author: edmen12

scripts.test: node scripts/prepare-tests.mjs && npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=4 dist/tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:fast: npm run build && node scripts/run-test-group.mjs fast
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/prepare-tests.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/run-test-group.mjs integration
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/browser-runtime.test.js dist/tests/browser-playwright.test.js dist/tests/browser-tools.test.js
scripts.test:process: node scripts/prepare-tests.mjs && npm run build && node --test dist/tests/native-process-backend.test.js dist/tests/bridge.test.js
scripts.build: node scripts/check-version-consistency.mjs && node scripts/check-open-task-markers.mjs && node scripts/check-user-facing-contracts.mjs && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json
